definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the forward kept-character accumulator on an empty input sequence.
Conditional recurrence defining keptAcc when the current character occurs in the deletion string; its simplification attribute is used definitionally.
definitions.text:
rule keptAcc(iCons(X:Int, XS:IntSeq), C:IntSeq, A:IntSeq)
    => keptAcc(XS, C, A)
    requires strContains(iCons(X, .IntSeq), C)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Conditional recurrence defining keptAcc when the current character is retained and appended to the accumulator; its simplification attribute is used definitionally.
definitions.text:
rule keptAcc(iCons(X:Int, XS:IntSeq), C:IntSeq, A:IntSeq)
    => keptAcc(XS, C, seqConcat(A, iCons(X, .IntSeq)))
    requires notBool strContains(iCons(X, .IntSeq), C)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the reversed kept-character accumulator on an empty input sequence.
Conditional recurrence defining reversedKeptAcc when the current character is deleted; its simplification attribute is used definitionally.
definitions.text:
rule reversedKeptAcc(iCons(X:Int, XS:IntSeq), C:IntSeq, A:IntSeq)
    => reversedKeptAcc(XS, C, A)
    requires strContains(iCons(X, .IntSeq), C)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Conditional recurrence defining reversedKeptAcc by prepending a retained character; its simplification attribute is used definitionally.
definitions.text:
rule reversedKeptAcc(iCons(X:Int, XS:IntSeq), C:IntSeq, A:IntSeq)
    => reversedKeptAcc(XS, C, iCons(X, A))
    requires notBool strContains(iCons(X, .IntSeq), C)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the final loop-target value when no input characters remain.
Recursive equation defining the final loop-target value as the last character traversed.

source_rules.rationale: Trusted loop-summary fact used to close SPEC: the finalized LOOP-SPEC proof uses a definition compiled with MPY-VERIFICATION as its main module, so this priority-40 rule is already present and is not first proved against a definition that excludes it.
source_rules.text:
rule
    <k>
      #loop(
        str(S:IntSeq),
        Name("character"),
        If(
          Compare(Name("character"), CmpOp("not in", Name("c"))),
          AugAssign(Name("result"), "+", Name("character"))
          Assign(
            Name("reversed_result"),
            BinOp("+", Name("character"), Name("reversed_result"))),
          .Stmts))
      => .K
      ...
    </k>
    <env> L:Int </env>
    <scopes>
      ...
      L |->
        ( scope(
            ( "s" |-> str(ORIG:IntSeq)
              "c" |-> str(C:IntSeq)
              "result" |-> str(A:IntSeq)
              "reversed_result" |-> str(RA:IntSeq)
              "character" |-> V:Val ),
            P:Parent)
        => scope(
            ( "s" |-> str(ORIG)
              "c" |-> str(C)
              "result" |-> str(keptAcc(S, C, A))
              "reversed_result" |-> str(reversedKeptAcc(S, C, RA))
              "character" |-> lastCharacter(S, V) ),
            P) )
      ...
    </scopes>
    [priority(40)]
